ruleDefinitions.name: OS Architecture Discovery Via Grep
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of grep to identify information about the operating system architecture. Often combined beforehand with the execution of "uname" or "cat /proc/cpuinfo"

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\/grep$") AND (process_command_line = RGX("aarch64$") OR process_command_line = RGX("arm$") OR process_command_line = RGX("i386$") OR process_command_line = RGX("i686$") OR process_command_line = RGX("mips$") OR process_command_line = RGX("x86\\_64$")))
